Question B-002-005-006.

Why the correct answer is right: K invites a reply from any station, so it is used when the transmission is open for someone to answer.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "End of message": End of message is a closing procedural signal such as AR; K invites a reply.
- sourceIndex 2: "Called station only reply": A called-station-only invitation is more restrictive than K.
- sourceIndex 3: "All received correctly": All received correctly is R, not K.
